title: Cold rebuild: A DHCP server
summary: Rebuild A DHCP server from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **A DHCP server** in *DHCP*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: A lease lasts 86400 seconds. When does the client try to renew (T1 = 50%) and rebind (T2 = 87.5%)?
steps.explain: Renewing early means a short server outage doesn't take every host offline.

steps.title: Rebuild A DHCP server cold
prompt: Write a class `DhcpServer` constructed with the first and last address of its pool:
- `string? Discover(string mac)`: offers (and reserves) the address this MAC already has, else the **lowest** free address, else `null` (pool exhausted).
- `string Request(string mac, string ip)`: `"ACK"` if `ip` is reserved for this MAC, else `"NAK"`.
MACs compare case-insensitively (`AA:00:...` and `aa:00:...` are the same client).
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
